pages.title: More Than a Pat
pages.text: Food and sound reveal peaceful reactions in small animals.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Give a basking seal three fish and await its returned item. Carefully wake a Rain Frog with a shovel and expose it to a disc; no weather change is promised. Falconry Glove is disabled, so Potoo glove transport is not required.
